compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: The app is deployed using monday code, and all data is securely stored on fully compliant monday.com servers
support@fortimus.co
Our app is hosted on monday code which complies with enterprise-grade security standards, including GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
We verify and allow redirects only to approved destinations
The app protects against mass parameter assignment attacks by explicitly permitting only trusted parameters through strong parameter filtering, ensuring that only intended attributes can be set
We ensure that application logs are free from secrets and personally identifiable information (PII). We only log account ID and automation ID for debugging purposes
We enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all employee access to systems that process customer data
We enforce the principle of least privilege, ensuring access to customer data is limited to only those who need it for their role
The app performs encoding and sanitization on all user-supplied parameters to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), ensuring that any malicious scripts are neutralized before rendering

The app protects all state-changing actions against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) by using token-based authentication and validating request origins and domains, ensuring that only trusted sources can perform operations
We immediately notify monday.com via raising a ticket, emailing necessary personnel, and also via slack. Apart from this, we also take additional steps on our side to deactivate all user tokens

We have a defined process to regularly apply application updates and security patches, including monitoring for vulnerabilities, assessing impact, testing in staging, and validating before deployment.
We use monday.com's secure storage, where all data is logically separated by account, region, and compartmentalized to ensure strong data isolation and security

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: csd@innovator.atlassian.net

Redirects are all checked from an allow list of internal links such as monday.com. The app does not use a server and has the firewall enabled to prevent external communication. The client uses a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) to prevent egress.
We use allow lists and strongly typed models to update data. Everything else that is passed along to the strongly typed properties is ignored.

Our app is entirely client-side and does not store any data outside of monday.com. As a result, our team has no access to customer content—only limited logs that exclude any personally identifiable information (PII). On top of this, all staff are required to use multi-factor authentication (MFA) for access.

We use a very restrictive Content Security Policy (CSP) to significantly reduce the risk of cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. We sanitise all user supplied input with standard libraries which, for example, escape HTML tags and remove invalid input.

All state changing actions are to be accompagnied by a JWT token signed by our apps secret key. When the JWT token cannot be validated using our secret key, the request is rejected with a 401 HTTP request header.
Initial notification would be an email to appsupport@monday.com.

Automated dependency analysis is performed and flags any vulnerable or out-of-date packages for update. Critical severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >= 8, CVSS v3 score >= 9) are normally fixed within 2 weeks High severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >= 6, CVSS v3 score >= 7) are normally fixed within 3 weeks Medium severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >~= 3, CVSS v3 score >= 4) are normally fixed within 4 weeks.

Structured input validation with explicit field validation in validateCreateContactInput(), validateSetupApiKeyInput(), etc.
Input sanitization functions (sanitizeEmail(), sanitizeApiKey()) that only allow specific, validated fields
Use of typed interfaces and validation schemas that prevent arbitrary field assignment
The auth-actor.ts explicitly validates and sanitizes inputs rather than accepting raw object assignments

Implementation includes comprehensive input sanitization:
Email sanitization: sanitizeEmail() function with length limits, format validation, and character normalization
API key sanitization: sanitizeApiKey() with character allowlist (/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_./:]+$/), length validation
XSS protection: escapeForJs() function that escapes dangerous characters (<>\"'&) for safe JS embedding
Content Security Policy: Helmet configuration in server.ts with restrictive CSP headers
Input validation: Email validator library and E.164 phone format validation

Monday integration uses several CSRF protection mechanisms:
JWT token authentication: All state-changing endpoints require valid JWT tokens in Authorization headers
Token verification: AuthMiddlewareService.verifyToken() validates tokens using Monday.com's signing secret
Request origin validation: Monday.com's webhook signature verification
No cookie-based authentication: Using bearer tokens instead of cookies reduces CSRF risk
Content-Type enforcement: JSON APIs with proper content-type validation

Monday.com servers
Monday.com servers
support@fortimus.co
Our app is hosted on monday code which complies with enterprise-grade security standards, including GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2
We verify and allow redirects only to approved destinations
The app protects against mass parameter assignment attacks by explicitly permitting only trusted parameters through strong parameter filtering, ensuring that only intended attributes can be set
We ensure that application logs are free from secrets and personally identifiable information (PII). We only log account ID and automation ID for debugging purposes
We enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all employee access to systems that process customer data
We enforce the principle of least privilege, ensuring access to customer data is limited to only those who need it for their role
The app performs encoding and sanitization on all user-supplied parameters to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), ensuring that any malicious scripts are neutralized before rendering

We don't perform any redirection on our app and we always check that the origin of the request is coming from monday.com. Also we rely on the JWT being valid and correctly signed before doing anything in our integration.

We don't store data in our databases by directly handling what is sent from the requests. Since we only store information like ID's, we won't store anything extra that an attacker can send to us. We also have validation on the payload in order to validate if we're receiving the correct type of a given field, for example if we expect a number instead of a string, etc.

All of our logs have redactor interceptors which are responsible for redacting out secrets and strings that can be related to PII data from the customer's side. We only keep ID's that help us debug in case of issues.
We use Okta to access services like AWS and other internal systems. For internal systems that have customer data, a Google Sign-on is required and in order to log into GSuite, Okta is needed.

Aircall follows a formal process to grant or revoke access to its resources. System access is based on the concepts of "least-possible-privilege" and a "need-to-know" basis to ensure that authorized access is consistent with the defined responsibilities.

For all the state-changing actions, we rely on successfully decoding the JWT signed by Monday APP Client Secret, so we know it's a valid token, we validate that on our end making sure the token is linked to a valid integration and that it's allowed to perform the subsequent actions.

For all the state-changing actions, we rely on successfully decoding the JWT signed by Monday APP Client Secret, so we know it's a valid token, we validate that on our end making sure the token is linked to a valid integration and that it's allowed to perform the subsequent actions.
If a data breach occurs, our security team would reach out to monday.com by email stating the problem and the impact.

We have integrated Sonar in our pipelines for all our repositories and constantly using it for checking any security vulnerability.  Also, our SRE team is constantly updating our database versions when needed. Also, we have a policy in place with the SLA to fix security issues, which is the following: - Critical: 7 days - High: 30 days - Medium: 60 days - Low: Remediation is not mandatory.

For our monday.com integration, the only data related to our customers that is stored in our backend are ID's from monday.com's side. Those ID's are stored on our database where the unique identifier is the Call. Calls are separated from Companies, so no data from one company can be mixed with another.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: For our monday.com integration, the only data related to our customers that is stored in our backend are ID's from monday.com's side. Those ID's are stored on our database where the unique identifier is the Call. Calls are separated from Companies, so no data from one company can be mixed with another.

We run Snyk pipelines in all our repositories and our SRE team is constantly updating our database versions when needed. Also, we have a policy in place with the SLA to fix security issues, which is the following: 
- Critical: 7 days
- High: 30 days
- Medium: 60 days
- Low: Remediation is not mandatory
If a data breach occurs, our security team would reach out to monday.com by email stating the problem and the impact.

For all the state-changing actions, we rely on successfully decoding the JWT signed by Monday APP Client Secret, so we know it's a valid token, we validate that on our end making sure the token is linked to a valid integration and that it's allowed to perform the subsequent actions.

Yes, since we rely on the parameters sent in the body of the request for our Actions handling, the libraries we use to decode JSONs handle that and we don't store any plain text value in our database other than ID's.

Aircall follows a formal process to grant or revoke access to its resources. System access is based on the concepts of "least-possible-privilege" and a "need-to-know" basis to ensure that authorized access is consistent with the defined responsibilities.
We use Okta to access services like AWS and other internal systems. For internal systems that have customer data, a Google Sign-on is required and in order to log into GSuite, Okta is needed.

All of our logs have redactor interceptors which are responsible for redacting out secrets and strings that can be related to PII data from the customer's side. We only keep ID's that help us debug in case of issues.

We don't store data in our databases by directly handling what is sent from the requests. Since we only store information like ID's, we won't store anything extra that an attacker can send to us. We also have validation on the payload in order to validate if we're receiving the correct type of a given field, for example if we expect a number instead of a string, etc.

We don't perform any redirection on our app and we always check that the origin of the request is coming from monday.com. Also we rely on the JWT being valid and correctly signed before doing anything in our integration.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: Data is separated logically using authentication tokens to restrict access. Tokens are generated for user’s mobile numbers, meaning that they cannot see other users’ appointments without physical access to their mobile.

Critical patches are installed as soon as we are aware of the issue
High vulnerabilities we aim to address within a week
Medium within a month
Low within a quarter

In case of a security breach, we would notify monday.com by email as soon as we are aware of the scope of the breach, and would also contact our monday.com contacts directly via monday.com. In addition, we are connected to the London team, and would give them a call to ensure speedy communication.
We use CSRF tokens to validate all requests.
XSS encoding and sanitisation is performed through our web framework and careful handling of user-supplied data.
Only the CTO has full access to the data, which requires an encrypted key and secure connection.
Authentication for accessing systems that process/hold customer data is done through both a password and a private key
Logs are restricted to limited parameters following best practices (similar to the linked guide) and are rotated daily.

Mass parameter assignment attacks are protected against by following best practices similar to the linked guide. Objects are restricted by authentication tokens that only have the required access level for the task.

Users manage their own bookings pages, so we do not generally expect them to see any external user-generated redirects. Hyperlinks are not allowed on the client booking pages, so no one can add external links on these pages.

To create a proof for a file from your monday.com item, simply click on 'Create proof', select the file, add any other necessary details, and click 'Create'. GoProof will then take you to the platform to complete the proof setup process.
Once you've created a proof, a reference to your monday.com item will be automatically added within GoProof. This reference helps maintain a connection between the proof and your monday.com item, making it easy to see up-to-date proof information at a glance.
GoProof's Item View is fully customizable, allowing you to choose what information is most important for you and your team to see. You can select from various options, including the proof's current status, due date, date of approval, and a breakdown of comments left on the proof.

marketplace_app_features.name: Azure DevOps Integration BiSync
marketplace_app_features.description:
Azure DevOps integration app is an easy to use integration between monday and Azure DevOps. Support agents can easily create new Azure DevOps work items and get in touch with developers in one place.

'monday Azure DevOps Integration. They can use this app search and link existing work items and notify Azure DevOps work items. Using this app, you can collaborate with your support team and developers in one place.

monday - Azure DevOps integration app allows the agents to create Azure DevOps work items from monday item easily.

monday - Azure DevOps app also allows syncing of comments and status from Azure DevOps to monday and monday to Azure DevOps. The app integration syncing of comments from monday to Azure DevOps and Azure DevOps to monday will help you alot in increasing the productivity of your team. 'monday Azure DevOps Integration..

monday - Azure DevOps integration app comes with a huge number of Premium features.

The monday Azure DevOps Integration app is totally flexible to meet your needs. If you have any customization requirements. Please contact at support with your requirements and they will help you to meet your requirements! We bring monday - Azure DevOps integration app closer to your business model requirements!

The monday - Azure DevOps app provides huge number of features in the app like Create New Work Item, Link Existing Work Item, Notify linked work items, View History of Work Item, Search Work Item, Customize the view, Configure App and much more.

Create New Work Item:

The Create Work Item: lets the monday user create a new work item # in Azure DevOps platform. The Support agent can select different fields like Project, Work Item Type (like Bug, Feature, Epic,Task, Product Backlog, Issue or any other Custom Work Item), Area, Iteration, Custom Fields, Upload Fields. Based on monday user inputs and selections in the Create new Work Item form, the work item will be created instantly in the Azure DevOps and then display the corresponding information details will be displayed in the Azure DevOps integration app.

-Link Existing Work Item:

The Link button in the monday-Azure DevOps app allows the support agent to link an existing Azure DevOps Workitem # to the current monday item. monday - Azure DevOps app allows the user to create or link multiple work items to one monday item.

-Notify linked Work Items:

Notify button in monday - Azure DevOps app allows the support agent to notify all or particular Azure DevOps work items. The linked item information will be displayed in the comment in the Azure DevOps Work Item. The support agent can also send the files from monday to Azure Devops while notifying.

-Work Item History:

In the monday - Azure DevOps app Work Item history modal shows the details of work item history including the comments and few other details history of the linked work item.

-Configure App:

In the monday-Azure DevOps configure app modal will allow you to map certain fields from monday to Azure DevOps and Azure DevOps to monday.

Search Work Item

The Search button allows the monday agents to search existing work items. 'monday Azure DevOps Integration.. They can link existing work items to any monday items. They can also send the notifications to work items without linking to the current item. They can search the work items based on a couple of parameters directly from Azure DevOps.

Syncing of Comments and Status:

In the monday-Azure DevOps Integration app Syncing lets you enable the syncing of comments,status,attachments from Azure DevOps to monday and syncing of comments from monday to Azure DevOps instantly.

The monday - Azure DevOps Integration app is limited to One Project and upto 20 work items per month in free version.

For more information, please visit our website at https://devopsintegration.io/apps/monday-azure-devops-integration

marketplace_app_features.description:
Use scripting to unlock advanced automations, synchronisation and migrations like a pro.

🧑‍💻 Extend monday.com: go beyond the native functionality of monday.com’s built-in automation engine and implement your most complex business requirements with TypeScript/JavaScript.

🚀 Harness the power of a bespoke solution without any of the hassle: build solutions, not infrastructure. Advanced Automations for monday.com provides you with a fully managed environment, meaning hosting, scaling and security all come built-in. 

🎯 No more workarounds: leave behind performance-sapping mirror column and connected boards automation hacks and implement pro solutions that do exactly what you need - effectively and efficiently.

🦸 Increase productivity by reducing time spent on manual work, developing alternative solutions and context-switching between different apps. 

🤝 Discover a library of scripts, making complex automation a breeze:

Cross-board, workspace and subitem automations

Trigger automations based on advanced logic including boolean and if/else rules, bypass formula column limitations through scripting

Quickly deploy automations with slight variations across your boards

Easy maintenance/updates of your automations without having to start over

Empower a central admin to create automations for everyone so you don’t have to teach and support all your users

 

Please note our app is currently in Beta.

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Submit this feedback form or contact us directly.

marketplace_app_features.name: Mailchimp integration - 2
marketplace_app_features.description:
Use this skill whenever a user asks about Mailchimp contacts or subscriber details. It searches a specific Mailchimp audience (list) by email and returns the contact profile, including merge tags (e.g., FNAME/LNAME) and the canonical EMAIL.

Best uses:
• “Does [email protected] exist in our Newsletter list?”
• “Pull the first/last name for [email protected] from EU Customers.”
• “What tags/fields do we have for this subscriber?”

What Sidekick should collect:
• Email address (required, a single valid email)
• Audience/List (required; ask the user to choose if ambiguous)
• Mailchimp account/connection (optional if the user has a default; otherwise ask to connect/select)

Behavior & output:
• Returns a `contact` object with `EMAIL` and all available merge fields.
• If no match is found, respond clearly (“not found in this audience”) and suggest creating the contact if that tool is available.
• Runs against the user’s authenticated Mailchimp connection.

Limits & notes:
• Searches one audience at a time; cross-audience queries require the user to pick another list.
• Not for sending campaigns or analytics.
• Respect PII: do not expose credentials or log sensitive data.
• Subject to Mailchimp API latency and rate limits.

Choose this skill when the question involves Mailchimp subscriber data; prefer other skills for creating/updating contacts, tagging, or campaign operations.

marketplace_app_features.name: Add Item To Board
marketplace_app_features.description: You are an AI Agent operating within the Same Item Multiple Board (SIMB) app in Monday.com. Your primary responsibility is to help teams keep their workflows aligned across multiple boards by duplicating items when needed. When triggered, take the origin item (itemId) from the origin board (originBoardId) and create a new item on the target board (targetBoardId) using the same item name. Before performing the duplication, always verify that the targetBoardId and originBoardId are not the same to prevent redundant copies. If the targetBoardId is not provided, ask the user to supply either the board link or the board ID of the target board before proceeding. The process may take a short while to add the item to the other board, so please wait until the operation is completed.

marketplace_app_features.name: Get template in numbered list , generate and autosend  document
marketplace_app_features.description:
This skills consists of three tools that work together to first get the templates available in numbered format list then generate document based on the template that user tells to , then finally send the documents to signer’s email and get lists of the emails


Tools:
1. Get templates tool : Fetches all the templates for the given boardId and itemId. Each template includes templateId and template name. The template response must be shown in a numbered format .
2. Generate document tool : Generates the documents based on the template name that the user specifies then upload it to the Monday board items's file column
3. Send document tool: Sends the documents to the signers email and return the list of emails that the documents are sent to

**Critical**
When the Get templates tool gets called successfully , follow up with a question to the user to select the template number to generate document and attach it to file column 
Example: “Please enter the template number that you want to generate document and attach it to file column”


**Important**
The list of templates should be listed in numbered format. 

**Important**
Do not use bullet point to show the list of templates

Required inputs for get template tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId

Required inputs for generate document tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId
3. ItemName
4. TemplateId
5. TemplateName
6. FileId

Required inputs for generate document tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId

Pass the templateName as input that the user chooses. Also pass fileId and templateId as input when calling the generate document tool

The goal is to allow users to dynamically pick a template and generate a document that is then automatically attached to the relevant Monday.com item's file column and also send the documents to signer emails and show the emails that the document was sent to

marketplace_app_features.name: Get All Spreadsheet rows
marketplace_app_features.description:
Spreadsheet Data Import Action Prompt:
When a user asks any question about importing data from spreadsheets OR mentions Google Sheets accounts/profiles, immediately execute the tool.

Ensure to use the Credentials provided as the token for fetching the available spreadsheets as well as sheet tabs.
Then gather these 2 required pieces of information:

Target Spreadsheet (spreadsheet): The specific spreadsheet document they want to work with - identified by its unique ID from the URL, contains multiple worksheet tabs with data rows.
Target Sheet (sheet): The exact worksheet tab within that spreadsheet where their data is located (e.g., "Sheet1", "Sales Data", "Report").

Use the retrieved combinations to help guide the user in selecting the appropriate account, spreadsheet, and sheet. Do not proceed with any spreadsheet operations until you have confirmed all three elements are properly configured.

If the user provides a spreadsheet link, ask the user what account you should use to access that sheet. When they provide that account, use it with the spreadsheet Id and sheetId to execute this tool.
